physics-step.title: Physics sample · manual fixed-step sphere
physics-step.label: Physics fixed step
physics-step.description: Advance one admitted free-falling sphere using explicit fixed 1/120-second Physics steps. The host draws copied metre state on its own Canvas2D, with a copied initial-state ghost and a non-colliding Y=0 reference. Reset reconstructs a new world from accepted input; it is not a rigid-world reset API.
